notes.title: Update 2023!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31595174/e564eb98bbed5f23decb17e9ac4a2766b4184221.png

The latest update for Zombie Derby 2 is out now!

List of changes:
- Steam Deck support.
- Improved gamepad controls.
- Improved game launch in "Big Picture" mode.
- Tactile effects (vibration).
- New settings window.
- Improved game balance (all cars are free).
- Fixed an issue with stars at Level 6.
- Better music quality.

Get 50% off on Zombie Derby 2: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/762590/Zombie_Derby_2/

Enjoy the game! 😎
